Vamsi has built and worked with evaluation loops for LLM systems across both work and projects:

- **At CVS Health:** He wrote telemetry endpoints that stored user ratings, comments, and prompt metadata in Cosmos DB as a human-in-the-loop eval loop. This data was used to drive prompt fixes, surface bugs, and prioritize new features for GAILE, an internal conversational AI platform used by hundreds of employees.
- **In his Retail Support AI Agent project:** He wrote a tau-bench-style eval framework comprising 12 multi-turn scenarios graded on final database state rather than transcripts. Using this framework, he iterated prompts through the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC), raising task success from 75% to 100% and escalation accuracy from 83% to 100%.

(Sources: resume, Retail Support AI Agent README)
